scripts.dev: npm run build -w @hivetalk/shared && concurrently -n shared,server,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @hivetalk/shared" "npm run dev -w @hivetalk/server" "npm run dev -w @hivetalk/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hivetalk/shared && npm run build -w @hivetalk/server && npm run build -w @hivetalk/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @hivetalk/shared && npm run lint -w @hivetalk/server && npm run lint -w @hivetalk/web
